name: 比利时单一许可
summary: 面向非欧洲经济区或瑞士人士在比利时受雇超过 90 天，由雇主向相应地区申请工作与居留许可。
summaryEn: For non-EEA or Swiss nationals employed in Belgium for more than 90 days, with the employer applying to the relevant region.

jobOffer.summary: 须有合资格雇佣、派遣或工作批准安排。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A qualifying employment, transfer or work-authorisation arrangement is required.

qualification.summary: 须满足该路线适用的技能、资格、经验或职位条件。
qualification.summaryEn: The route-specific skill, qualification, experience or position requirements must be met.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的工资、配额、劳动力市场、地区或经济利益审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any salary, quota, labour-market, regional or economic-interest assessment in force when applying must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
